clips.title: The story
paras: A Prairie Wolf Heart is a vital organ harvested from the wolves roaming the grasslands of Mulgore. It serves as an essential ingredient in an urgent folk remedy prepared by Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village to counteract venomous infection.

The wolves of the plains are fierce predators, hardy and persistent across the sweeping grasses of Mulgore. Their hearts are sought out by Maur Raincaller, a tauren residing in Bloodhoof Village who fell victim to the legendary plainstrider known as Mazzranache. Struck by the creature's virulent, fever-inducing venom, Maur relies on traditional plains medicine to halt the spreading poison. Alongside other potent reagents like cougar bone and bird gizzard, the vital essence of a freshly slain prairie wolf provides the cleansing properties needed to concoct a cure before delirium proves fatal.
